keyEvents.text: Goal! Preston North End 1, Sheffield United 0. Léo Leroy (Preston North End) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Andrija Vukcevic with a cross following a fast break.
Delay in match because of an injury Johnny Kenny (Preston North End).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Preston North End. Callum Lang replaces Johnny Kenny because of an injury.
Goal! Preston North End 1, Sheffield United 1. Sydie Peck (Sheffield United) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Harrison Burrows.

Goal! Preston North End 1, Sheffield United 2. Sydie Peck (Sheffield United) right footed shot from outside the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Ben Brereton with a through ball following a fast break.
Goal! Preston North End 1, Sheffield United 3. Sydie Peck (Sheffield United) right footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Romelle Donovan.
Substitution, Preston North End. Caleb Wiley replaces Andrija Vukcevic.
Substitution, Preston North End. Liam Lindsay replaces Jordan Storey.
Second Half begins Preston North End 1, Sheffield United 3.
Substitution, Sheffield United. Oliver Arblaster replaces Jairo Riedewald.
Substitution, Sheffield United. Femi Seriki replaces Tahith Chong.
Substitution, Preston North End. Alfie Devine replaces Jusef Erabi.
Léo Leroy (Preston North End) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Sheffield United. Jordan Ayew replaces Hamza Choudhury.
Goal! Preston North End 2, Sheffield United 3. Callum Lang (Preston North End) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Alfie Devine.
